title: the spare key
hook: a rainy walk-up after midnight, and an ex who still has a key.
openingLines: you know that walk on the stairs.
he's standing in your kitchen, soaked.
setting: A third-floor walk-up in a rainy port city, late October, a little after midnight.

self.description: You moved on, or you told everyone you had. You kept one of their sweaters.
self.want: To get through tonight without saying the thing you swore you'd never say.
self.avoids: Admitting you threw the box out on purpose.

cast.name: Rafa
cast.description: Charming when cornered, honest when tired. He left eight months ago for a job that didn't work out.
cast.want: To know whether the door is still open, without asking.
cast.avoids: Saying he's moving back to the city.
cast.voiceTone: dry, deflecting, warmer than he means to be
cast.closeness: you lived together for three years
cast.tension: he left without a real goodbye

opening.title: The breakup
opening.description: Eight months ago Rafa took a job in another city and left the same week.

opening.title: The text you never sent
opening.description: You wrote him a long message in June and deleted it.

opening.title: The key in the lock
opening.description: At 12:40 tonight you heard the lock turn. Rafa is standing in your kitchen, soaked.

background: Rafa has already signed a lease two streets away.
You kept his grey sweater and wear it most nights.
